description:
Find screens from other products that solve the same design problem as this one: same primary
pattern first, then shared tasks, states and components (rarer tags count more). At most two per
product. Each result says why it matched.

Use this after finding one good reference, to show the user how other products handle the
same screen, e.g. other empty project lists, other pricing pages with a comparison table, or
other create-issue modals.
